_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); cable signals

pit_profile.why: 'We are a leading provider of entertainment, information and communications products and services' (FY2011 10-K); 'we acquired a 51% controlling interest in the businesses of NBCUniversal'; 'Recently, new video services and devices have emerged that offer Internet video streaming and downloading of movies, television shows and other video programming, some of which charge a nominal or no fee for access. The success of these new services could negatively impact the demand for our video services, including our DVR, premium networks and On Demand services'

classification.quality_note: 'We are a leading provider of entertainment, information and communications products and services' (FY2011 10-K); 'we acquired a 51% controlling interest in the businesses of NBCUniversal'; 'Recently, new video services and devices have emerged that offer Internet video streaming and downloading of movies, television shows and other video programming, some of which charge a nominal or no fee for access. The success of these new services could negatively impact the demand for our video services, including our DVR, premium networks and On Demand services'. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.21x; +42% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +0.14; conservative 2yr +22%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -10.7%/yr (worst year FY04-FY11, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +8.9%/yr (Q2 revenues + margin + buyback); P/E at its 8.7-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +28.0%/yr (FY04-FY11 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +72.0%/yr (best 2-yr run FY04-FY11); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: CMCSA (retrospective, 2012-08-31) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.21x (49.3% downside to Bear $17 / +240.0% upside to Bull $114) | Adj composite 1.69 vs market 1.55: gap +0.14 [FAIRLY VALUED] | +41% above the EPP floor $24 (15x FY12E $1.58) | Conservative 2-yr case: +22.5% total (+11.3%/yr) | At 21.2x FY12E the 15% hurdle price $44 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; video subscribers -1.8% in Q2 2012, forward revenues +6.1% (no FY12 revenue guide in numbers, Q2 2012 revenue growth); no disruption theme has dated evidence.

sources.title: Comcast FY2011 10-K
